description:
Map a file analysis (from analyze_file) to Smartpress product candidates: productId, productName, a rationale citing the analysis evidence, a 0-1 confidence, and machine-readable matchSignals. Candidates are ordered by confidence (max 5).

Pass the analysis object returned by analyze_file (or just the uploadId to have it fetched). Use get_product_config on a candidate's productId to see its options before creating a configuration session for the user's chosen candidate.

analysis.description: The results object returned by analyze_file (or its .analysis sub-object).

uploadId.description: Alternative to analysis: the analyze_file uploadId; results are fetched if ready.

name: recommend_products
